description: This file is a shell script containing tests for Git's 'skip-worktree' feature, including setup, various test cases, and verification commands.

methods.name: setup_absent
methods.description: Removes file '1', then updates the git index to add it with a cache info and marks it as skip-worktree.

methods.name: test_absent
methods.description: Verifies that the file '1' is absent from the index and filesystem.

methods.name: setup_dirty
methods.description: Removes file '1', creates a modified version with content 'dirty', updates git index and marks it as skip-worktree.

methods.name: test_dirty
methods.description: Checks that file '1' remains in the index with the expected stage and content after setup.
